sources.snippet: DistilBERT is a small, fast, cheap and light Transformer model based on Bert architecture. It has 40% less parameters than bert-base-uncased, runs 60% faster while preserving 97% of BERT's performance as measured on the GLUE language understanding benchmark. sources.snippet: Lets see some core features of DistilBERT Compact Model Architecture: DistilBERT reduces the number of parameters from 110 million to 66 million making it significantly smaller than BERT. This reduction in size allows for easier deployment on low-resource devices without compromising essential capabilities.
